title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 05, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4545 stands out on the visible solar disk today as a sunspot region associated with recent M-class activity.

📍 Location: N20E07
☀️ Region: AR 4545
🔥 Recent activity: 1 M-class flare · 1 C-class flare

Somebody brought freckles to work.

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Image: N/A
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
